segments.text: That all beleevers in the time of this life, are in a continuall warfare, combate, and oppoſition againſt ſinne, ſelfe, the world, and the Devill, and liable to all manner of afflictions, tribulations, and perſecutions, and ſo ſhall continue untill Chriſt comes in his Kingdome, being predeſtinated and appointed thereunto; and whatſoever the Saints, any of them doe poſſeſſe or enjoy of God in this life, is onely by faith.
